privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.noAuth: This site stores nothing about you. No account, no cookies beyond your own settings in this browser, no analytics.
privacy.auth.intro: Signing in is only for students of this class. Here is exactly what is stored and why.
privacy.auth.items: Your email address (to sign you in) · your name (to check you are in this class) · an automatically assigned study code · the date you gave consent · what you did on the site (which week, which tab, quiz answers, when). Nothing else.
privacy.auth.recordings: Voice recordings you make in Repeat, Shadow or Role-play never leave your device.
privacy.auth.whyText: To let your teacher see how the class uses the site and to support her research on language learning. Taking part in the research is optional; you can use the site without it.
privacy.auth.whoText: Only your teacher. Research exports use your study code, not your name or email.
privacy.auth.withdrawText: From your Profile page at any time. Withdrawing deletes your activity log.

consent.p1: This site is also part of a research study exploring how students use digital review materials between classes.
consent.p2: Taking part is completely optional. You can still use all the learning materials on this site if you choose not to take part, and your decision will not affect your marks or your course in any way.
consent.p3: If you choose to take part, you will be given a study code (such as P007). The site will record how you use the learning materials, including which weeks and tabs you open, what you play, your quiz responses, and when you use the site.
consent.p4: Your name is used only to confirm that you are a student in this class and for your profile. Your email address is used only to sign you in. Research data is linked to your study code rather than your name or email address.
consent.p5: Voice recordings never leave your device.
consent.p6: You can withdraw from the study at any time from the Account section of My page. If you withdraw, your recorded activity data will be deleted.
signin.classCodeHint: Your teacher gives this out in class. You only need it the first time.
